name: The Test of Righteousness
summary: In Ironforge, glad tidings bring Jordan Stilwell news of his wife. Duthorian Rall sends you from Westfall to tell the devout smith that Daphne survived the Defias attack.

sections.title: A Messenger of Good News
sections.body: Duthorian Rall sends you from Cathedral Square with news for Jordan Stilwell. You have guarded Daphne Stilwell through a Defias ambush at her Westfall homestead, and she survived. Her husband left for Ironforge believing his family was in danger. Rall asks you to carry the news in person, so Jordan can know his wife is safe.

sections.title: The Smith of Dun Morogh
sections.body: Jordan Stilwell was once destined to join the paladins, but chose to follow his father's craft as a master weaponsmith. He works at his anvil outside Ironforge's gates, keeping his faith as he shapes weapons. When you tell him Daphne survived the Defias attack, gratitude moves him to help you forge a blessed weapon of righteousness.

faq.answer: Jordan Stilwell is a devout weaponsmith who works outside Ironforge's gates. He once studied the ways of the Light alongside paladins, then chose to continue his father's smithing craft.

faq.q: Why was Jordan's wife in danger?
faq.answer: Daphne Stilwell lives on a farmstead in Westfall, where Defias Brotherhood outlaws threaten the people. Jordan feared an attack when he left for Ironforge. Bandits stormed the farm, but paladin initiates drove them off.

faq.q: Where can Jordan Stilwell be found?
faq.answer: Jordan Stilwell works outside Ironforge's main gates in Dun Morogh. He prefers the mountain air to the Great Forge inside the city.

faq.q: Why does Duthorian Rall send the player to Ironforge?
faq.answer: Duthorian Rall sends you to tell Jordan that Daphne survived the Defias attack. The journey also brings you to a master smith who can guide you in making a sacred paladin weapon.

faq.q: What comes after speaking with Jordan?
faq.answer: After hearing the news, Jordan offers to help you forge a holy warhammer. He asks you to gather rare materials and sanctified relics from distant lands.

faq.q: How does Jordan feel about the Defias threat?
faq.answer: Jordan is angered by Stormwind's council and its neglect. The Defias Brotherhood has plagued Westfall for a long time, and he hopes attacks on honest homesteads will force the boy-king's regents to face the crisis.

angles.text: As a paladin, you move from protecting the weak to crafting sacred tools to purge evil across Alliance lands.
As an Alliance member, you see Westfall's common folk struggling against the Defias while royal advisors in Stormwind delay action.
As a blacksmith, you can see how Jordan's work at the anvil expresses his devotion as surely as wielding a consecrated blade in battle.
